lines: Thukrao ab ke pyaar karo, main nashe mein hoon.
couplets.en: Turn me away or love me this time, I am drunk.

lines: Thukrao, thukrao, thukrao ab ke pyaar karo, main nashe mein hoon.
Jo chaho mere yaar karo, main nashe mein hoon.
couplets.en: Turn me away or love me, my dear, do as you will with me while I am drunk.

lines: Thukrao, thukrao, thukrao ab ke pyaar karo, main nashe mein hoon.
couplets.en: Turn me away or love me this time, I am drunk.

lines: Ab bhi dila raha hoon yaqeen-e-wafa magar.
couplets.en: Even now I am trying to persuade you that my love is true.

couplets.en: I am still trying to convince you of my devotion, though I am too drunk for you to take my word.

lines: Mera na aitbaar karo, main nashe mein hoon.

couplets.en: You can hardly take my word when I am this drunk.

lines: Girne do, girne do tum mujhe, mera saaghar sambhaal lo.

lines: Mujhko qadam qadam pe bhatakne do, waaizo.
